text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? What did you say, Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...It's good to be enthusiastic, but let me
offer you a warning. There
are some real
monsters here that feed on that
enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono
text_block_list.text: M-monsters?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Th-there's no such thing... right? You're
saying that as a metaphor...
right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry. Yeah—I'm talking about the
protagonists of the
academy. You'll see
Teio and McQueen aren't the only shining
stars
here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here has dreams and the raw
skills to see them through. It's
a hearty
full-course feast of protagonists, each with
their own rivals!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Dreams, skills... and rivals.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I'm all fired up now! Count me in! I
wanna learn more about
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, then today's your lucky day!
'Cause I'm gonna teach you
about some of
those so-called monsters! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nin-nin mode, activate. You two've met
Helios and Palmer, right?
They hype up
the crowd with their flashy breakaway
styles!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yep, that's all true, but... why all the
lurking in the shadows? Why not
just go
up and talk to them?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Reconnaissance is all about being a ninja.
With that, my little
fledglings—on to the
next mission! Nin-nin!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono
text_block_list.text: Yes, master! Nin-nin!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Those three are known as BNW, and
they're always competing for first
place. I
think there've even been races where they
all finished in the
top three.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that's so cool! So hey, do you think I
could be called... KSB?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's the cool part?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Those two seem like they're
arguing about something...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yep, business as usual! They haven't debuted just yet, but they really don't want to lose to each other. They're future hot tickets for sure!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Future hot tickets... Wow! Everyone is so
different! There really might
be some
formidable "monsters" here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, we've barely scratched the
surface... Buuut it's already
late, so let's
call it a wrap for today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser, you're so knowledgeable.
You've even looked into the
racers who
haven't debuted yet...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
This much is normal. Everyone researches
their opponents before a
race, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You would be one to call that "normal."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Aha! I found you, Sneakyhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sneakyhauser? ...Wait, do you mean me?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong, Turbo? Why do you
seem so worked up?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I heard what you're gonna do, Machitan!
You're gonna run in that,
uh... "XC vision"
race, aren't you?! With Bourbon and Rice!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
And you're gonna wear your racewear!
That's so unfair! I wanna run
too! Don't
leave me out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono
text_block_list.text: Bourbon and Rice?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It turns out that Bourbon and Rice are
scheduled to race tomorrow, so
we hurry
over to the track to do some
reconnaissance for our ninja
master.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono
text_block_list.text: Whoooa!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Did you see that just now, Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I definitely did, Kita. Those racers are
Rice Shower and Mihono
Bourbon...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Their running is so powerful... They might
even be a match for Teio
and McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
They do seem pretty monster-like. Is
Tannhauser really gonna go up
against
them?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait, where is Tannhauser anyway?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah—Kita, Sato! Nice timing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Check out this letter! It says, "I'm cheering
for you! Do your best!"
Hehehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Is that from the little girl we met the other
day?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! It puts a smile on my face to
know someone out there is
pulling for me!
All right, I'm gonna give it my
AAALL—ack!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aah! A-are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haha, it's just a nosebleed. I must've gotten too excited. Sniff, sniff... Okay, all good now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um... Rice and Bourbon are both really
fast. Are you feeling okay
about the race?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmm, well... I've raced those two a bunch of times already. And I can tell you, they're good! Really good!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can beat them through
hard work alone. Just gotta
hope for a
miracle! May the gods give me strength,
namu-namu!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Uhh, I'm not sure that's gonna work... But
hold on to that spirit and do
your best!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... She really said there's "no way" she
can win. Now I'm getting
all worried... Will
she be okay tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean. I'm a bit worried
too. But I think despite what
she says,
she's still determined not to lose.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's go cheer her on tomorrow! I
get the feeling it's going to
be a fantastic
race.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume's Journal
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow's the big day. I'm feeling pretty
nervous... But it's
okay—I've done all I can
to prepare. I hope I don't let down the

people supporting me!"
